acceptance: Local entity-query validation failure does not create unresolved runtime ownership or permanently block the native workflow.

implementation.admission: One shared nonblank32768UTF16 query text bound used by store admission and core plan validation.
implementation.ownership: Validate plan synchronously before task creation/progress/choice reset. Local validation errors show a message and return with no unresolved attempt ID. Preserve exact attempt retention for failures after executor or runner execution begins.

verification.regressions: ASCII/emoji UTF16 overflow and whitespace produce zero executor calls; stale catalog plan rejection leaves no latch; valid edit/restore queries again and permits Run after valid entity selection. Existing post-execution unresolved fences still pass.
verification.review: Sol read-only verification of reported bug and final fix clear.

limitations: Native store contract tests and app build only; rendered UI and live entity/device execution remain unqualified. Full M0-M6 remains incomplete.
